info.name: Localo — Seller Auth + Test Emails + Test Push
info.description:
Seller OTP login + test-email and test-push APIs for QA.

Run **Seller Auth → Request OTP**, then **Verify OTP** (OTP and token are captured automatically), then any request under **Test Emails**. Emails go to the logged-in seller's own address. For pushes, set `fcmToken` to a real device FCM token and run **Test Push → Register push token** first.

`baseUrl` defaults to QA (`https://loccalo.in/api`); request paths keep the `/api/sellers/...` prefix the seller panel uses. For local, set `baseUrl` to `http://localhost:3000`.

Default seller: Riddhima Shopee (+91 9314403888, riddhima@yopmail.com).

request.description: Sends a 4-digit OTP to the seller's mobile via MSG91. The response includes `otp`, which is saved to the `otp` variable automatically.
Verifies the OTP and returns `{ token, accountRestored, seller }`. The token is saved to `sellerToken` and used by every other request.
Invalidates the current session and clears `sellerToken`.
Every testable seller email type with its subject.
Sends all 18 seller emails (both first_product_nudge reminders) sequentially to the caller. Returns `{ to, sent, failed, emails[] }`.

**Welcome seller** (`welcome_seller`). Transactional (push: false in production; test API sends anyway).

Sent only to the logged-in seller's own registered devices (run **Register push token** first, else 404). Skips notification settings, quiet hours, caps and dedupe; writes a real inbox row. Response shows FCM's outcome per device and the exact `payload` sent. Omitted `params` are auto-filled from the seller's latest product/boost/offer.
